newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Crackdown on Portuguese tax evasion working-FinMin.
newsitem.headline: Crackdown on Portuguese tax evasion working-FinMin.

text.p: A crackdown on tax evasion is saving Portugal dozens of billions of escudos, Finance Minister Antonio Sousa Franco said.

He told reporters that the government's target to recoup 110 billion escudos in tax and social security arrears would be surpassed as many firms were repaying debts to the state under the so-called Mateus Plan.
The Mateus Plan, named after Economy Minister Augusto Mateus, aims to help ailing firms recover by awarding them bank financing with the backing of state guarantees.
